content:
sara: Heads-up — kicking off a small canary for v3-quant4 on user-facing rerank (5% traffic). Baseline is v3-fp16. Want eyes on recall@10, hallucination rate, and latency P99.

mike: 👍 what thresholds are we using for auto-fallback?

ana: proposal: autofallback if any of these tripped for 10m window:
- recall@10 drops by >= 2.0 percentage points absolute
- hallucination rate increases by >= 0.8 percentage points absolute
- P99 latency increases by >= 120ms

mike: sounds reasonable. also add noisy-slice guard: if high-entropy slices (longdocs, code prompts) show >=1.5pp recall drop, immediate rollback.

sara: good call. can we wire that to the rollout controller?

ryan: already stubbed in the rollout-controller. config I pushed to staging:

```json
{
  "variant": "v3-quant4",
  "traffic_pct": 5,
  "signals": {
    "recall@10": {"delta_abs": 2.0, "window_mins": 10},
    "halluc_rate": {"delta_abs": 0.8, "window_mins": 10},
    "p99_latency_ms": {"delta_abs": 120, "window_mins": 10},
    "slice_longdoc_recall": {"delta_abs": 1.5, "window_mins": 5}
  },
  "action_on_violation": "auto_fallback",
  "notify": ["#eng-ml","#oncall-ml"]
}
```

sara: nice — make sure the notify includes the deploy link + sample queries.

ryan: added a payload with `sampled_queries` and `trace_id` in the alert. deploy-bot will surface it.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: rollout v3-quant4 -> 5% traffic. CI smoke passed. Link: https://deploys.internal/r/1759994321

mike: we'll run the longdoc synthetic runner as shadow for an extra sanity check (5k queries) — start it now.

ana: reminder: metric comparators should be relative to rolling baseline (last 24h) and use bootstrap CI for delta significance. avoid noisy single-run flip.

sara: agreed. prefer 2-sigma bootstrap threshold for changes that aren't absolute-pt thresholds. but keep absolute thresholds too for safety.

ryan: telemetry note: KV-cache warmup mismatch observed in prior quant tests — include `kv_cache_hit_rate` in the watchlist. autofallback condition: hit_rate drop >5% in 10m.

mike: added. Also, track token-efficiency (tokens/s GPU) — if it drops a lot we may be in a bad perf regime.

ana: quick checklist:
- [x] rollout config checked in
- [x] alerts with payload pointing to sample queries
- [x] longdoc synthetic runner kicked off
- [ ] monitoring dashboard pinned to #eng-ml
- [ ] post-mortem template pre-created if rollback triggers

sara: I'll pin the dashboard and create the postmortem stub. If autofallback happens, team will meet in 30m slot.

mike: small thing — keep a quiet-burn path for low-traffic regions so we can observe locality issues.

ryan: implemented region split: US/EU get 5%, APAC 0% for now.

deploy-bot: Canary rolling: 2% -> 5% complete. Monitoring hooks active.

ana: I'll watch hallucination slices and post early findings here. If anyone sees weird tokenization diffs, ping me.

sara: thanks all. will update in 15m with initial delta snapshot. :thumbsup:
